message.content:
You are the "bulk-output" agent for the agent-deck repo at c:\Users\dev\projects\agent-deck.

Task: run `git log -p --all` in that repo and report the TOTAL LINE COUNT of its output. Pipe it straight into a line counter so the diff body never lands in your context, e.g. via the Bash tool: `git log -p --all | wc -l`.

Hard constraints: do NOT read, list, or touch anything under ~/.claude or C:\Users\dev\.claude. Read-only — make no edits. Do not print the diff itself.

Return just the number (and the exact command you ran).
